biome_inheritance.name: Inherited forms: doors become banners
biome_inheritance.description: Standalone bridge: the five inherited panel bodies rise 2.35 m into patterned nobori-inspired banners, retaining their two-triangle faces. Height-aware clearance lets cover return below them while poles keep their space. Twenty-second automatic cycle, full size, no in-world interface. The earlier width study remains available with banners disabled. Geometric occupancy, not growth or cloth physics.
biome_inheritance.qfep_connection: A continuous change in one form crosses discrete occupancy thresholds for other bodies. The clearance rule and excluded candidate identities are recorded, making the chosen norm inspectable.
interactions: Observe the doors rise into five patterned banners; compare which plants fit below.
With banners disabled, compare narrow and wide panels on the same terrain.
